source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of UV-visible spectroscopy (PDF 190-192).

blocks.text: Ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) spectroscopy sab se maqbool tajziyati tareeqon mein se hai kyunke yeh hama jehat aur aasan hai. UV-Vis roshni sample se guzari jati aur roshni ki transmittance (T) napi jati hai; absorbance (A) A = -log T se nikalti hai. UV-Vis spectrum mukhtalif wavelengths par maadde ki absorbance dikhata hai, aur kisi wavelength par absorbance molecule ki electronic banawat par munhasir hai.

Compound mein sigma electrons (sigma bonds mein), pi electrons (sirf unsaturated compounds mein) aur n electrons (non-bonding, lone pairs) ho sakte hain. Sigma bonding orbitals sab se kam tawanai, pi bonding zyada aur non-bonding us se bhi zyada tawanai par hain. Munasib frequency ki radiation jazb hone par electron in mein se kisi orbital se khaali anti-bonding orbital, sigma* ya pi*, mein jata hai. UV-Vis spectroscopy taqreeban 200-800 nm wavelengths use karti hai. Ahem transitions pi se pi*, n se pi* aur n se sigma* hain.

Buta-1,3-diene, CH2=CH-CH=CH2, sab se zyada 217 nm par jazb karta hai; sab se zyada absorption ki wavelength lambda max kehlati hai. Yeh UV hisse mein hai, is liye koi nazar aane wali roshni jazb nahi hoti aur compound be-rang hai. Is mein non-bonding electrons nahi, is liye sirf pi se pi* transitions nape jate hain.

Lambda max conjugation ki wusat par bohat munhasir hai, jaisa butadiene (217 nm), hexatriene (257 nm) aur octatetraene (290 nm) dikhate hain. Conjugated nizam mein electrons lambi zanjeer par bate hote hain; compound jitna zyada conjugated, utni zyada tawanai ki satahein aur un ke darmiyan farq utna kam. Kam farq ko kam tawanai chahiye, is liye kam frequency aur lambi wavelength ki roshni jazb hoti hai. Har izafi conjugated double bond aam taur par lambda max taqreeban 30 se 40 nm barhata hai, aur bohat conjugated compounds nazar aane wali roshni jazb kar ke aksar chamakdar rangeen hote hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: tawanai ki satahein neeche se oopar sigma, pi, n, pi* aur sigma*, teer sigma se sigma*, pi se pi*, n se sigma* aur n se pi* ke liye. Oopar daen: buta-1,3-diene ka absorption spectrum, 200 aur 300 nm ke darmiyan 217 nm par aik chotti. Neeche: butadiene (217 nm), hexatriene (257 nm) aur octatetraene (290 nm), baari baari double aur single bonds ki zigzag zanjeerein.
blocks.caption: Electronic transitions, butadiene ka spectrum aur conjugation ka asar (Figures 29.4 aur 29.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: n se pi* chhalang sab se chhoti aur sigma se sigma* sab se bari hai. Conjugated zanjeer mein sab se oopar bhare pi orbital aur sab se neeche khaali pi* orbital ka farq zanjeer barhne se ghat'ta, is liye lambda max lambi wavelengths ki taraf jata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Hara tamatar aur paka surkh tamatar mukhtalif rang ke hain: hare tamatar mein chlorophyll zyada aur surkh mein lycopene hota hai. Dono compounds ki lambda max qeematein mukhtalif aur is liye nazar aane wale hisse mein khaas rang hain.

blocks.title: Spectrum se complex ka rang
blocks.text: Agar transition metal complex nazar aane wali roshni ke kisi hisse mein jazb kare to woh complementary rang ka dikhta hai (Chapter 18, colour wheel): narangi roshni jazb karne wala complex neela dikhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Sigma se sigma*, pi se pi*, n se sigma* aur n se pi* mein se kis ko sab se kam tawanai chahiye? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: n se pi*: non-bonding electrons sab se zyada tawanai wale bhare orbitals hain aur pi* sab se kam tawanai wala khaali orbital, is liye yeh farq sab se chhota hai.

blocks.prompt: Barhti lambda max ki tarteeb mein likhein: (i) CH3CH2-C(=CH2)-CH=CH-CO-CH3, (ii) CH2=CH-CO-CH3, (iii) CH2=CH-CH=CH-CO-CH3.
blocks.explanation: (ii) < (iii) < (i): (ii) mein do conjugated double bonds (C=C aur C=O); (iii) aur (i) mein teen teen; (i) ki conjugated zanjeer par alkyl (ethyl) group bhi hai, jo lambda max thora aur barhata hai. (Banawatein chhape khaakon se parhi gayin.)

blocks.prompt: Kya CH3CH(OH)CH3 UV-Vis hisse mein qabil-e-zikr absorption dikhayega?
blocks.explanation: Nahi: propan-2-ol mein sirf sigma aur n electrons hain; is ke sigma se sigma* aur n se sigma* transitions ko 200 nm se kam wavelength chahiye, jo 200-800 nm ki had se bahar hai.

items: Transitions: pi se pi*, n se pi*, n se sigma*; n se pi* ko sab se kam tawanai.
Zyada conjugation: kam farq, lambi lambda max (217, 257, 290 nm).
